title: angorkis recurva
intro: Angorkis recurva, commonly known as Indian gentian or gentian root, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, aiding in digestion, and exhibiting antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities. The health benefits of Angorkis recurva include its ability to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and sore throat, while its therapeutic actions include its antispasmodic and expectorant properties. Bioactive constituents of Angorkis recurva include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
